message: Hi, I'm a student with a python certification background. My overall academic average is 75.7% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and developer. I want to become a Network Engineer. My family can afford at most about USD 3400 per year. I live in Hyderabad. I cannot leave my city.
explanation:
Ashford Institute of Applied Sciences
This program is highly recommended because its MTech Computer Networks specialization directly aligns with your goal of becoming a Network Engineer and includes relevant fields like "networking_cloud." The annual tuition of $3350 USD fits within your maximum budget, and your academic background meets the minimum requirement (71%). The main trade-off here is that while it offers excellent career prospects—including an 80% placement rate and a median salary of $12561—it requires you to have a Computer Science background.

Charnock Institute of Technology
This MTech Cyber Security program is a strong fit because its focus on "software_engineering" appeals to your interest in development, while the degree itself provides technical depth for networking roles. At an annual tuition of $2450 USD, it remains well within your budget constraints and does not require a CS background. The main trade-off you should consider is that the primary specialization is Cyber Security rather than pure Network Engineering, although its competitive median salary ($12765) makes up for this.

Elmhurst School of Engineering
This MSc IT Management program offers an extremely low annual tuition of $1000 USD and has a good placement rate of 77%. It is suitable because it does not require a CS background, making admission straightforward given your current qualifications. The main trade-off with this option is that the curriculum focuses heavily on "it_management," which means you will be pursuing a management track rather than the deep technical skills needed for a core Network Engineer role.

Vantage Technical University
This PG Diploma in Systems Administration is highly affordable, costing only $700 USD annually and focusing on relevant fields like "networking_cloud." It also meets your admission criteria as it does not require a CS background. The main trade-off with this program is the significantly lower median starting salary of $6514 compared to other options, which might limit your initial earning potential despite its low cost.

Sarayu Institute of Technology
This MBA Technology Management option offers the highest placement rate (81%) and a strong median salary of $13142 USD, making it financially appealing. The tuition is also affordable at $1250 USD, and it does not require a CS background. However, the main trade-off to consider is that this program is an MBA focused on "it_management," meaning the curriculum will emphasize business strategy over the deep technical networking skills you are aiming for.
